findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "avaliar" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_construction, search, contact, consulta_comprar · Private data: search_construction, health, get_cnpj, reveal_cnpj, sintonia_seal, dossier_cnpj, search, suggest, contact, add_watch, reactivate_watches, consulta_cadastro, consulta_sugerir, consulta_cnpj, consulta_planos, consulta_comprar, consulta_lote, api_access, api_access_buy, get_api_x402_cnpj_by_cnpj · Public sink: search, contact, api_access_buy · Destructive: get_cnpj.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_construction, search, contact, consulta_comprar · Private data: search_construction, health, get_cnpj, reveal_cnpj, sintonia_seal, dossier_cnpj, search, suggest, contact, add_watch, reactivate_watches, consulta_cadastro, consulta_sugerir, consulta_cnpj, consulta_planos, consulta_comprar, consulta_lote, api_access, api_access_buy, get_api_x402_cnpj_by_cnpj · Public sink: search, contact, api_access_buy · Destructive: get_cnpj

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
